# clumio_iceberg_tables (Data Source)

clumio_iceberg_tables data source is used to retrieve details of the Iceberg tables for use in other resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example using the table name
data "clumio_iceberg_tables" "ds_iceberg_tables" {
  account_native_id = "AWS Account ID"
  aws_region        = "AWS Region"
  name              = "Iceberg table name"
}

# Example using the catalog, namespace and catalog type
data "clumio_iceberg_tables" "ds_iceberg_tables" {
  account_native_id = "AWS Account ID"
  aws_region        = "AWS Region"
  catalog           = "Iceberg catalog name"
  namespace         = "Iceberg namespace"
  catalog_type      = "aws_iceberg_glue_table"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_native_id` (String) The identifier of the AWS account under which the Iceberg tables were created.
- `aws_region` (String) The AWS region associated with the Iceberg tables.

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) The catalog of the Iceberg tables to be queried.
- `catalog_type` (String) The catalog type of the Iceberg tables to be queried. The supported values are `aws_iceberg_glue_table` and `aws_iceberg_s3_table`.
- `name` (String) The Iceberg table name to be queried.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the Iceberg tables to be queried.

### Read-Only

- `iceberg_tables` (Attributes List) List of Iceberg tables which matched the query criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--iceberg_tables))

<a id="nestedatt--iceberg_tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `iceberg_tables`

Read-Only:

- `catalog` (String) Catalog of the Iceberg table.
- `catalog_type` (String) Catalog type of the Iceberg table.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the Iceberg table.
- `name` (String) Name of the Iceberg table.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the Iceberg table.
